title: Uros Medic vs. Kevin Holland prediction, pick, start time, odds for UFC 334
text:
Uros Medic vs. Kevin Holland pick, prediction, time: UFC 334 Videos Blue Corner Schedule Results Rankings Fighters A.S. 1980-2025 💙 Newsletter UFC Uros Medic vs. Kevin Holland prediction, pick, start time, odds for UFC 334
 Dan Tom MMA Junkie Nov. 14, 2026, 12:01 p.m. ET Uros Medic and Kevin Holland meet on the UFC 334 main card at Madison Square Garden in New York.   Check out this quick breakdown of the matchup from MMA Junkie analyst Dan Tom. 
 Last event's results: 3-3
 UFC main cards, 2026: 125-79-1
 Uros Medic vs. Kevin Holland UFC 334 preview
 Medic (14-3 MMA, 8-3 UFC) has called the doctor for his past four opponents, as he's finished them all in the first round. His incredible run includes stoppages of Gilbert Urbina, Muslim Salikhov, Geoff Neal, and Daniel Rodriguez.
 Holland (29-15 MMA, 16-12 UFC) got back on track in April with a unanimous decision win over Randy Brown. That win followed back-to-back losses to Rodriguez and Mike Malott.
 Uros Medic vs. Kevin Holland UFC 334 expert pick, prediction
 Filling out the main card is a potential crossroads fight at welterweight between Uros Medic and Kevin Holland.
 Medic, who is coming off a massive main event win in his home country of Serbia, is making a fairly quick turnaround to take on a name opponent in Holland.
 Although seeing Medic continue his success by quickly starching an aging Holland wouldn't exactly shock me, I can't say that I'm sold on "The Doctor" just yet.
 Aside from the fact that he's gotten a deceptively kind deal of proverbial deck as of late, the 33-year-old is relatively unproven past the first frame and still has a bad habit of upright, linear retreats when pushed.
 Add in the fact that Holland has a fairly solid winning record against UFC-level southpaws (standing at 8-4-1), and I can't help but side with the more experienced man.
 The official pick is Holland to score a club-and-sub in Round 2. 
 Watch UFC 334 with Paramount+ Uros Medic vs. Kevin Holland UFC 334 odds
 Despite the oddsmakers opening the American as the favorite, public money has flipped the line in favor of the Serbian fighter, listing Medic -160 and Holland +130 via FanDuel.
 Uros Medic vs. Kevin Holland UFC 334 start time, how to watch
 Medic and Holland are expected to walk to the cage at approximately 9:40 p.m. ET. The fight streams live on  Paramount+ .
